# Acceptance-criteria traceability report

**Generated by `scripts/render-traceability-report.py` from the committed register and the 17 records. Do not edit by hand; CI checks it is current.** It changes no status. The frozen plans are unchanged.

* Criteria: 34. Accepted: **0**. Planned, implemented, executed and accepted are four independent fields.
* PHPUnit cases recorded in the register: 181.
* Reviewer designation and independence: Reviewer: Designated human reviewer, designated by the owner (instruction recorded 2026-11-13); declarations are held privately by the owner. Technical inspection support (a service the reviewer directs) is not a separate reviewer and cannot sign or declare for the reviewer; the owner accepted this arrangement on 2026-11-13, which verifies no independence check. Independence: NOT VERIFIED (8 independence checks are open; see documentation/REVIEW-PLAN.md). Manual records prepared in documentation/acceptance-records/: 17 (14 reviewer-run, 3 owner-run); completed: 0; pending: 17. A completed record is evidence, not acceptance, and does not change accepted_count.
* C26-003 to C26-006: M2-D tooling is implemented and tested (documentation/UPGRADE-VERIFICATION.md); the criteria are NOT satisfied, not waived and not accepted: they need a registered source and target, an independent reviewer, an approved attestation and an authorised hosted run

## 2. Open gaps recorded per criterion

* **1 Theme installs and activates:** Not run on the CI matrix (MySQL 8.4, PHP 8.4)
* **2 Plugin installs and activates:** C02-004 covers the unsupported-WordPress path only; unsupported-PHP path cannot be exercised on PHP 8.3 without a constant override
* **3 Both work together:** C03-001 accessor-to-theme is exercised only through the browser fixtures, not a dedicated test
* **4 Theme deactivation does not delete structured content:** C04-001 compares record counts only; C04-002 (content still viewable after switch) not tested
* **6 Dashboard content can be created and edited:** C06-001 and C06-002 are implemented for all five types and pass locally in a real browser, but have not run in the WE environment (wp-env), which the plan requires
* **8 Private clearance data cannot be retrieved publicly:** In-process probes only (accessor, query, meta, search, REST, routes, export). Rendered HTML, feeds and sitemap bodies are not probed over HTTP with sentinels
* **9 Unauthorised users cannot approve publication:** Forged-request test covers one handler; no full per-role HTTP matrix
* **10 Incomplete clearance blocks publication server-side:** C10 WP-CLI path now real (see C24); manual walk-through pending
* **11 Empty homepage sections stay hidden:** C11-001 and C11-002 are implemented, but the available execution used a shim, not wp-env, which the plan requires
* **12 No unfinished placeholders appear publicly:** C12-001 is implemented; the core sitemap seed needs Apache (wp-env) and has not been exercised. WordPress default sample content (Hello world, Sample Page) is reported as a warning and must be deleted before launch
* **13 Layout works at 360, 768 and 1280 px:** No archived screenshot evidence in the repository; manual review pending
* **14 Keyboard navigation works:** Automated support only; manual keyboard pass is the acceptance test
* **15 WCAG AA contrast met:** Automated axe covers 11 pages at two widths; manual review pending
* **16 PHP lint and PHPCS pass:** Lint executed on PHP 8.3 only; PHP 8.4 lint and the PHP 8.5 informational run need CI
* **17 Naming compliance passes without exposing the term:** The owner has not run the scan. The term list is never in the repository
* **19 Both ZIPs install on a clean WordPress:** Clean site is a copy of the local WordPress, not the CI-fetched release
* **20 Installation and recovery instructions documented:** Link check not run on the new documents; recovery rehearsal not done
* **21 Classic Editor compatibility:** C21-021 (version and source match the verified pin): EVIDENCED by hosted strict run 43316091579. AWAITING OWNER ACCEPTANCE. Not accepted; C21-022 (record of the settings used): EVIDENCED by the settings record of strict run 43316091579 (classic-editor-replace=block; classic-editor-allow-users not stored, the plugin default applies). AWAITING OWNER ACCEPTANCE. Not accepted; Pin limits: the whole-ZIP SHA-256 was observed stable on one day only; the SVN revision was not recorded; the pin's checksums URL is the WP-CLI form and its live reachability is not independently confirmed; the SVN tag and the download host share one trust anchor; Configuration A tests C21-001 to C21-005, 011, 013, 015, 017, 019 passed 13/13 against the real package in capture run 43286920565 and strict run 43316091579. Configuration B ran in the wp-env job of run 43316091579 (step passed; its check count was not re-read); C21-M01 (manual editor check) is still pending, so criterion 21 as a whole is not accepted
* **22 Private approval status isolation:** In-process only; HTML and feed bodies not sentinel-probed over HTTP; editor and anonymous reads covered
* **23 Snapshot invalidation after editing public content:** Every public scalar field is covered via the registry; relationship, term, thumbnail, gallery membership and order, alt, caption, title covered once each; media file replacement covered by C29; video URL covered as a field; presentation flag covered as a field
* **24 Failed publication attempts through alternative write paths:** REST and XML-RPC paths are tested in-process with the endpoints enabled, not over HTTP
* **25 Database migration and upgrade integrity:** Upgrade tested from a simulated v1 (index dropped), the only earlier schema; MySQL 8.4 not run locally
* **26 Preservation of structured records through theme switching and plugin upgrades:** C26-001 and C26-002 now compare content hashes, metadata, relationship ID sets, clearance, approvals, media rights, settings and the existing audit entries, with a sensitivity check; executed through a shim, not wp-env; C26-003 to C26-006 are NOT implemented. They belong to M2-D and have prerequisites that need the owner (see documentation/C26-M2D-BOUNDARY-REVIEW.md): no earlier release exists to register, and the attestation needs a reviewer and a hosted run
* **27 Audit trail behaviour:** C27-001 is a static scan of includes/
* **28 Related-record dependency mechanics:** Loop-prevention, republish-after-lapse and snapshot-excludes-related-content not each asserted
* **31 Cache invalidation:** Core object cache only; no persistent object-cache drop-in test; purge action asserted per trigger, not "exactly once"
* **32 Ineligible content is not served through supported public interfaces:** In-process queries as an anonymous user; REST has no routes by design; get_posts() with suppress_filters bypasses the read-time filter (documented limit)
* **33 Required and optional relationship behaviour:** Presentation of the grace state is covered by the exposure test only
* **34 Audit key: missing, invalid, rotation and recovery:** Supplementary automated evidence only: the rehearsal is not the owner record C34-M01. No human has rehearsed rotation or recovery

## 4. Register against the frozen plans

`tests-cli/plan-register-consistency-test.py` compares the register and records with both frozen plans in CI. The one documented difference is C27-M01, which neither plan defines ([C27-M01-PROVENANCE.md](C27-M01-PROVENANCE.md)). The CI plan file used here has 195 lines and is not modified.
